posts.title: Defending the Honor of Writing
posts.description: Anthropic’s Claude is going to start watermarking the text it generates by making subtle word choices which, over the course of a long document, may reveal if it was largely AI generated. This initiative started due to a European Union regulation designed to help people understand if creative works are AI generated.
